name: Chengdu Ultra Pure Applied Material
summary: Chengdu Ultra Pure Applied Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development and manufacturing of semiconductor etching components, laser components, and special ceramics. The company's products include precision optics, such as laser optics, IR (infrared) optics, and SiC lightweight primary mirrors; semiconductors manufactured with UPAM patented purification technology and UPAM patented coating technology; and materials, such as cathodes, ceramic materials, SiC materials, and coating materials. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Chengdu, China.
